summary: The reported sunset warning was reproduced from GitHub's public comment API and was emitted by the external gemini-code-assist GitHub App, not repository-owned CI. Current base and upstream main contain no Gemini Code Assist reference under .github, so there is no justified source correction. Verifying or removing any inactive installation requires upstream repository/organization settings access and an upstream PR probe, both outside scope.
